Attribute Vultr by linking https://www.vultr.com/pricing/; show each price as an observation 'checked on <date>', never a current price, and imply no endorsement. Re-verify before enabling.

sources.name: NYC HPD: open housing-code violations per building (NYC Open Data)
sources.robots_note: robots.txt checked 2026-10-17: https://data.cityofnewyork.us/robots.txt does not disallow /resource/ (Crawl-delay 1; this is one request a week).
sources.terms_note: NYC Open Data's SODA API, dataset wvxf-dwi5, published by the Department of Housing Preservation and Development for public use under the NYC Open Data Terms of Use. One aggregate query a week: for every building with 10 or more open class C (immediately hazardous) violations, how many violations HPD lists as open, by class (C immediately hazardous, B hazardous, A non-hazardous), and the latest inspection day.
